name: Yoga school in Lima
reason: Three web searches. First candidate Zenda Yoga (zendayoga.com, Miraflores, 200-hour Yoga Alliance profesorado in three modules) is a Wix site: robots.txt allows us, but its photos live on static.wixstatic.com, which refuses our robots.txt, so no usable images. Second candidate The Yoga Journey (theyogajourney.net, Vinyasa 200-hour with coaching, 2027 dates per search snippet) is also a Wix site, same image problem. Other results were a personal teacher's shop (Fiorella Fuentes), a Miami-based visiting programme, or directories. Skipped; owner could add Zenda Yoga by hand with its own photos.
